basic_info.description: Gorgeous Sunnyside Home with desirable three bedrooms and two baths all on one level. Opening into a covered patio, an additional bedroom, family room and full bath on the lower level is perfect for in-laws, remote work office or a private space to relax. Beautiful refinished hardwood floors, new interior paint, new roof, large double pane windows, with updated kitchen and baths. The open kitchen features wood cabinets, under cabinet lighting, new stainless steel range, and a Vent-a-Hood range hood. Modern lighting in the dining room and a wood burning fireplace is featured in the warm and inviting living room. A large deck off of the top floor with access to the yard from both the upper and lower levels. Home shows pride of ownership.  Sunnyside Playground a block away, a short walk to Glen Park Bart, Balboa Bart, Monterey Blvd restaurants, Safeway and easy access to the 280 freeway, excellent public and private schools. Two-car garage with long driveway. This home has it all. Come home to your move in ready home.
